name: The Crooked House, First Floor
summary: The ground floor of the Lockwood manor, bent out of true: a storm-lashed porch, a tall foyer with a curving stair, a parlor with a spirit board, a round gallery, a music room, a dining room laid for a feast, a wrecked kitchen and a glass conservatory.
text: Rain drums on the porch. Inside, the floors lean, the doors sit in their frames at slight wrong angles, and every wall holds something that looks back.

exits.label: Stairs up to the second floor
Down the porch steps to the grounds
exits.locked_text: The storm hammers the steps. A foot off the boards is a foot into the lightning, and the house will not let you leave.

props.label: The porch's edge, where the storm waits
The Lockwood family portrait
props.text: A stern family stands in oils, the father's face made of the same long shadows as the man on the porch.

props.label: The Druskenvalds' portrait
props.text: A stern woman in a wicker choker, and beside her a man weeping under a crown that is not there.

props.label: A portrait of your own party
props.text: Your party stands in paint, every smile too wide and every mouth empty of teeth.

props.label: The curved stair
props.text: The stair bends round the wall in a long, lazy curve, its rail leaning like a drunk.

props.label: A compass rose inlaid in the floor
The round table and Adela's spirit board
props.text: A round table with a spirit board inlaid in its top and a heart-shaped planchette marked with two initials.

props.label: A crystal ball on a shelf
props.text: A crystal ball, clouded from within, sits on a shelf that has been dusted by someone, recently.

props.label: A cobwebbed fireplace
props.text: The hearth is a nest of cobweb, and the ash in it is much too fine for wood.

props.label: A marble peacock in its alcove
props.text: An albino peacock carved in marble, huge, its tail fanned and one eye a polished red stone.

props.label: A dour bust
props.text: The bust glares from its plinth with the look of a man who has never once enjoyed himself.

props.label: Keziah's landscapes
props.text: Rolling country in a thin, careful hand. The longer you look, the more of it is eyes, and fur, and teeth.

props.label: What is left of the peacock
A harpsichord gaping like a coffin
props.text: The harpsichord's lid is thrown back like a coffin's, and its strings hum faintly though nothing touches them.

props.label: A cracked oval mirror
props.text: An oval mirror, cracked across, shows the room with something dancing in it that is not there when you turn.

props.label: A table laid for a perfect feast
props.text: Roast, fruit, steaming bread and wine: a hot feast, spotless, in a room where every other thing wears dust.

props.label: Something glints among the plates
props.text: Under the edge of a plate, something small and bright.

success.text: Under the lip of a plate lie a heavy pearl and a plain gold band.

props.label: A fallen metal shelf
props.text: A tall metal shelf lies where it fell, its pots and tins strewn across the flags.

props.label: A living bergamot tree
props.text: One tree among the dead vines is green and heavy with fruit, as if it were fed by the rest.

props.label: A porcelain cup
props.text: A small porcelain cup sits on the flagstones, polished, with nothing in it and no dust on it at all.

props.call_when: not flag.crooked_man_seen_1 and (flag.seance_done or (flag.memento_gem and flag.memento_key) or (flag.memento_gem and flag.memento_cup) or (flag.memento_key and flag.memento_cup))

checks.label: Read the glyph on the padlock plate

success.text: You follow the glyph to its last stroke, and the heat drains out of the padlock plate.

failure.text: The glyph slides out from under your eye, and the plate stays hot.

traps.label: The painted stare
traps.text: The painted eyes find yours, and something cold presses in behind them.

traps.label: The painted stare
traps.text: The painted eyes find yours, and something cold presses in behind them.

traps.label: The painted stare
traps.text: The painted eyes find yours, and something cold presses in behind them.

traps.label: The storm at the porch's edge
traps.text: Lightning cracks down on the step and throws you back onto the boards.

traps.label: The thunder at the porch's edge
traps.text: The thunder lands like a fist.

traps.label: The screaming oven
traps.text: The padlock is hot, and the screams behind it get louder as you reach.

traps.label: The screaming oven's seep
traps.text: Something wet and sour seeps from the oven's seams.

round_events.name: Keziah's pull
round_events.summary: Oh, that posture will do nicely. Into the frame with you, darling.
round_events.text: Oh, that posture will do nicely. Into the frame with you, darling.
round_events.say: Five icy fingers catch your collar from the empty air, and the room tilts until you are fallin' into a sky reeking of wet oil.

table.name: Keziah's shade
table.summary: Do mind the tail, my pets. I spent a whole autumn setting those feathers just so.
table.text: Do mind the tail, my pets. I spent a whole autumn setting those feathers just so.

table.name: Keziah's shade
table.summary: Chin up, darling, and square your shoulders. Your stance is ruining the composition of the room.
table.text: Chin up, darling, and square your shoulders. Your stance is ruining the composition of the room.

table.name: Keziah's shade
table.summary: Heh heh heh. Marble keeps its poise so much better than warm flesh ever could.
table.text: Heh heh heh. Marble keeps its poise so much better than warm flesh ever could.

table.name: Keziah's shade
table.summary: You are all so deliciously lively, dears. What a pity to waste such bright colour on a cold stone bird.
table.text: You are all so deliciously lively, dears. What a pity to waste such bright colour on a cold stone bird.

table.name: Keziah's shade
table.summary: Hold still, for heaven's sake. A proper portrait requires patience, and I have all the time there is.

round_events.name: The dancing tune
round_events.summary: The tune from the harpsichord pulls at every heel on the floor: dance, or be worn down.

round_events.name: The dance wears you down
round_events.summary: Three turns of dancing and the legs give out.

round_events.name: Phantom Feast
round_events.summary: A dish from the laid table flies at whoever stands by it.

table.name: The sugar bowl
table.summary: The sugar bowl bursts across your face in a white cloud.

table.name: The roast fish
table.summary: The roast fish lunges, all bones, and the sweet rot on it sticks in your throat.

table.name: The lobster claw
table.summary: The lobster claw snaps shut on whatever is nearest.

table.name: The creampuff
table.summary: A creampuff flies into your open mouth, and you cannot breathe past it.

table.name: The beef tongue
table.summary: The beef tongue coils round your legs and holds.

rest_text: The house won't let you sleep. The walls tick and breathe round you, and something small keeps scratching behind the plaster. A short breath, then.
